section_summary.extract_value: This is an Implications section that discusses how the study's findings on body appreciation and sexual function have practical applications for professionals working with women. The section argues that promoting body appreciation, particularly in women with higher body weight, may be more beneficial for sexual health outcomes than focusing on weight loss. The text emphasizes that positive body perceptions may be a better predictor of sexual health than body size itself.
